clauses.expr: (A OR B) AND NOT (C XOR D)

provenance.source: section 2 of the LingoLOGOS ASIC specification, Combinatorial SMT Z3 Evaluator
dsl: AND, OR, XOR take two or more operands, NOT takes one, MUX takes exactly three
operands (select, when-set value, when-clear value), parentheses group.
Variables are the single letters A to H, mapped to the declared bit positions of the
note: Clauses 0 and 1 are the two examples the specification ships verbatim.
Clauses 2 and 3 exercise the deeper netlist shapes (nested AND/OR/NOT and a MUX whose
data inputs are themselves gates), because the four result lanes of the datasheet pin
table are four clause slots and slots 2 and 3 would otherwise be constant zero.
These four clauses are a hardware test network. They are not the compiled form of the
Z3 assertions produced by datasets/multilingual/tools/logic_map.py: no such compiler exists here.
